title: Ink and Switch Interactive Homepage
summary: Ink and Switch is a research studio specializing in local-first software and innovative interactive tools. Their interactive homepage showcases their work on creative applications, collaborative editing, and novel user interfaces. The site demonstrates their philosophy of building software that prioritizes user ownership of data and seamless offline/online experiences.
problem_solved: Enables local-first software development with offline capability and seamless collaboration
why_valuable: Demonstrates practical implementation of local-first principles, giving users control over their data while maintaining great user experience
